english translation text: MY VICTORORIOUS ABBAS WHERE ARE YOU

arabic text: SHAAM AGAYA HAI GHAZI HO TUM KAHAAN
english translation text: WE HAVE ARRIVED IN SHAAM WHERE ARE YOU ABBAS

arabic text: HAR BIBI BE RIDA HAI GHAZI HO TUM KAHAAN
english translation text: EVERY LADY IS WITHOUT HIJAB WHERE ARE YOU ABBAS

arabic text: MASHKO ALAM SAKINA SEENEY PE YUN SAJA KAR\nKOOZEY KO TAK RAHI HAI ABBAS KO BULAKAR\nPUR SOZ EK SADA HAI GHAZI HO TUM KAHAAN
english translation text: SAKINA HOLDS THE WATER BOTTLE AND THE ALAM\nLOOKS AT THE WATER BOWL AND CALLS OUT TO ABBAS\nWITH GRIEF AND SADNESS,WHERE ARE YOU ABBAS

arabic text: ZARRO KO HUKM DO YE PARDA MERA BANAYE\nKAANTO KA HAI SAFAR YE CHALNA KOI SIKHAYE\nMUSHKIL YE RAASTA HAI GHAZI HO TUM KAHAAN
english translation text: ORDER THE SAND TO MAKE VEIL OVER US\nWE WALK ON THE SHARP THORNS AND DONT KNOW HOW\nHOW DIFFICULT IS THIS JOURNEY,WHERE ARE YOU ABBAS

arabic text: NEZEY PE SAR AKHI KA QURAN PAR RAHA HAI\nMUJHE UN SARO ME GHAZI TERA SAR NAHIN DIKHA HAI\nZAINAB KI ILTEJA HAI GHAZI HO TUM KAHAAN
english translation text: ON THE SPEARHEAD MY BROTHER RECITES QURAN\nI CANNOT FIND YOUR HEAD AMONGST THE OTHERS\nZAINAB IS LOOKING FOR YOU WHERE ARE YOU ABBAS

arabic text: MEHMIL NA AMARI HAI PAYDAL HI CHAL RAHI HUN\nKOI RIDA DILA DE FARYAAD KAR RAHI HUN\nDIL MERA PUCHTA HAI GHAZI HO TUM KAHAAN
english translation text: THERE IS NO SADDLE OR SEAT I HAVE WALKED AND WALKED\nCAN SOMEBODY PLEASE GET OUR HIJAB I PLEAD\nMY HEART CALLS YOU AND WONDERS WHERE ARE YOU ABBAS

arabic text: ZEHRA KI LAADLI HUN LEHJE ME MURTAZA HUN\nQURAAN KI BAQA HUN ME BHI TO SAYYADA HUN\nTU MERA NA KHUDA HAI GHAZI HO TUM KAHAAN
english translation text: I AM THE BELOVED OF ZAHRA, I SPEAK LIKE ALI\nI AM ALSO THE SAVIOUR OF QURAN,I AM ALSO SAYYEDA\nAND YOU ARE MY SAVIOUR WHERE ARE YOU ABBAS

arabic text: HAATHO ME KHALI KUZA LE KAR SAKINA BIBI\nTUJHKO BULA RAHI HAI MASOOM SHAHZADI\nNAZRON ME ALQAMA HAI GHAZI HO TUM KAHAAN
english translation text: SAKINA HOLDS THE EMPTY WATER BOWL IN HER HANDS\nCALLS OUT FOR YOU THE INNOCENT PRINCESS\nLOOKS OUT TO ALQAMA AND CRIES WHERE ARE YOU ABBAS

arabic text: KHAAKE SAFAR BANI HAI MERI RIDA AY GHAZI\nTAUQO RASAN ME JHAKRA HAI NA TAWAAN MUHARI\nHAR ZULM SEH RAHA HAI GHAZI HO TUM KAHAAN
english translation text: SANDS OF MY TRAVEL IS MY VEIL NOW MY WARRIOR\nWEAK SAJJAD IS BOUND IN CHAINS AND THORNY BRACES\nHE IS ENDURING CRUELTY AND INJUSTICES WHERE ARE YOU ABBAS
